releaseNotes: Improved branch search with ranked results (exact, prefix, then partial matches) and highlighted matching text.
Added a "Default Branch" badge to the branch list and refreshed the branch and search icons.
Improved keyboard navigation in the branch selector so the search field keeps focus while moving through results.
Fixed the Lyte server hanging on an "already running lyte process" prompt by stopping the stale process before starting.
Fixed Lyte server startup errors on newer Node versions by disabling Node's experimental fetch for the Lyte process.
